SELECT SEQ_SAFETY_CHECK_MASTER.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SAFETY_CHECK_MASTER ( CHECK_ID, CHECK_DATE, CHECK_ROUND, INSPECTOR, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{checkId}, #{checkDate}, #{checkRound}, #{inspector}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO SAFETY_CHECK_DETAIL ( DETAIL_ID, CHECK_ID, ITEM_NO, STATUS_CODE, REMARK ) VALUES ( SEQ_SAFETY_CHECK_DETAIL.NEXTVAL, #{checkId}, #{itemNo}, #{statusCode}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CHECK_ID AS checkId, CHECK_DATE AS checkDate, CHECK_ROUND AS checkRound, INSPECTOR AS inspector FROM SAFETY_CHECK_MASTER ORDER BY CHECK_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT DETAIL_ID AS detailId, CHECK_ID AS checkId, ITEM_NO AS itemNo, STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, REMARK AS remark FROM SAFETY_CHECK_DETAIL WHERE CHECK_ID = #{checkId} ORDER BY DETAIL_ID ASC

SELECT r.RESULT_ID AS resultId, i.ITEM_ID AS itemId, i.TARGET_TYPE AS targetType, i.CATEGORY AS category, i.ITEM_TITLE AS itemTitle, i.QUESTION AS question, r.USER_ID AS userId, r.CHECK_STATUS AS checkStatus, r.REMARK AS remark, TO_CHAR(r.CHECK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS checkDate FROM CHECKLIST_ITEM i JOIN CHECKLIST_RESULT r ON i.ITEM_ID = r.ITEM_ID WHERE i.TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} AND TRUNC(r.CHECK_DATE) = ( SELECT MAX(TRUNC(CHECK_DATE)) FROM CHECKLIST_RESULT sub_r JOIN CHECKLIST_ITEM sub_i ON sub_r.ITEM_ID = sub_i.ITEM_ID WHERE sub_i.TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType} ) ORDER BY i.ITEM_ID ASC
